scope: Application-layer household policy edits and shared administrator proof preparation; no public HTTP or installed image change
testFirst: Policy behavior tests initially failed because policy_commands did not exist, then passed after implementation
assertions: Revisioned profile/mapping changes commit policy, receipt, audit and outbox together without rewriting members
Selected eligible ordinary HA users can hold deliberate Domus administrator authority and edit policy
Changing mapping removes inherited grants and preserves independent explicit administrator profiles
Setup-only mode binds the unique committed setup actor; missing, malformed or ambiguous audit provenance fails closed
Selected/setup targets must be active linked eligible humans; setup target must remain a current HA administrator
No external lookup holds the SQLite writer lock; fresh actor reproof follows external preparation
Current authority, unchanged member/policy snapshot and a remaining eligible administrator are checked in the writer transaction
Source outage or confirmed lack of another eligible administrator leaves the existing policy unchanged
An interleaved member/policy change is a conflict instead of silently overwriting current authority
Canonical rule order, authorization before receipt replay, stale revision conflicts and restart durability are verified
All previously passing member concurrency and same-key activation cases remain passing after shared proof extraction
schema: Still schema 2; bounded setup-provenance read uses existing immutable audit without a data migration
